document: Experimental importer capability vocabulary (not an OTIO standard)

required_behaviour.unsupported_native_feature: Explicitly report unsupported feature; never silently claim native editable preservation
required_behaviour.lossy_fallback: Only with explicit opt-in, identified loss list, and viable derived media or executable effect mapping
required_behaviour.unknown_custom_schema: May reject or retain opaquely; never promise import without extension support
required_behaviour.missing_or_ambiguous_media: Do not auto-relink; flag for user resolution
